title: GenomeRevision
description: One immutable version of a bot's definition. Only spec and policy are hashed into revision.id (README §3.2). Rules that JSON Schema cannot express (list order, uniqueness of keys, engine-specific persona types, nesting of resources) are stated in README §3–§4 and checked by the Genome Registry.

genome_schema.description: Version of this format; 1 for genome v1 (README §1).

digest.description: Address of stored bytes in the manifest content store: 'sha256:' and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes (README §3.3).

revisionId.description: Identity of a revision: 'sha256:' and the hex SHA-256 of JCS({spec, policy}) (README §3.2). Same spec and policy, same id.

safeInteger.description: An integer that every JSON implementation represents exactly, so hashing never depends on float handling (README §3.1).

riskTier.description: Approval tier of a change, T0 (lowest) to T3 (needs the owner's approval); see risk-tiers.json and README §6.3.

genePath.description: README §2. A category, then '/'-separated segments; bytes outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] and the segments '.' and '..' are percent-encoded (uppercase hex).

personaType.description: An identity file type the Manifest accepts. The set a given bot accepts is narrower and depends on its engine (README §4.2).

skillName.description: The Skill Center package name rule: apply requires the SKILL.md metadata name to match it and to equal the entry name. Reserved names are refused case-insensitively.

resourcePath.description: Workspace-relative; trailing '/' marks a directory entry. No empty, '.' or '..' segment.

memoryKey.description: Stable name of one curated memory item, e.g. 'returns-window'; patch ops address an item by it.

evidenceRef.description: Reference to an Experience record that motivated a change or an item: 'episode:<id>', 'feedback:<id>' or 'eval:<id>' (01-genome.md §2.2).

sortedUniqueStrings.description: A list of strings without duplicates, sorted ascending in code-point order (README §3.1). JSON Schema checks uniqueness; the Registry checks the order.

personaFile.description: One identity file of the bot (SOUL.md, RULES.md, ...). Keyed by type; the content is stored and referenced by digest.

type.description: Which identity file; at most one entry per type.

digest.description: The file's bytes, which must be valid UTF-8.

skillEntry.description: One skill of the bot. oneOf: the entry matches exactly one of the three shapes, chosen by origin. 'local' is a bot-owned skill whose files are stored; 'center' is a Skill Center skill pinned by version and not copied; 'repo' is a skill supplied from the platform-synced shared skill repository, named by its repository path (README §4.2).

oneOf.description: A bot-owned skill; its files are stored as one acm-tree-v1 tree.

name.description: The skill's name and key; equals the SKILL.md metadata name.

origin.description: Marks this shape: a bot-owned skill.

digest.description: acm-tree-v1 of the skill's files; must contain SKILL.md.

oneOf.description: A governed Skill Center skill, pinned by version (ADR 0010).

name.description: The skill's name in Skill Center, and its key.

origin.description: Marks this shape: a Skill Center skill.

center_version.description: The published Skill Center version this revision uses.

oneOf.description: A skill supplied from the shared skill repository, by repository path; neither copied nor version-pinned (README §4.2).

name.description: The skill's name as the bot sees it, and its key.

origin.description: Marks this shape: a shared-repository skill.

repo_path.description: The skill's path inside the shared skill repository (what follows git:// on the skill row): relative, /-separated, no empty, . or .. segment, no backslash or control character.

memorySpec.description: The bot's curated memory as it appears in spec: the facts, rules and lessons the bot should start with (01-genome.md §7). Not the engine's runtime memory, which the bot writes itself and which is never in a revision. The items themselves are stored separately (memoryItems) and referenced by items_digest.

mode.description: How apply writes the curated items into the engine's memory. seed: write an item only if the engine has no item with that key, keeping everything already there. merge: write every item, overwriting the same key, keeping runtime items with other keys. replace: the engine's memory becomes exactly the curated items and runtime items are dropped (T3).

items_digest.description: The stored item list (memoryItems), as canonical JSON (README §4.4).

memoryItem.description: One curated memory item, inside the stored list that memorySpec.items_digest points at.

key.description: The item's key, unique in the list.

text.description: The fact, rule or lesson itself, e.g. 'Returns are accepted within 30 days.'

source.description: What the item was learned from, e.g. ['episode:ep_97']. allOf: the value must satisfy both schemas, so it is a sorted list without duplicates whose every entry is an evidenceRef.

memoryItems.description: The format of the stored blob items_digest points at: the curated memory items, sorted by key. Not part of the revision document itself.

resourceEntry.description: One file or directory the bot has in its workspace, keyed by path.

path.description: Where the resource goes in the workspace; ends in '/' for a directory.

digest.description: File bytes, or acm-tree-v1 for a directory entry.

mcpConfig.description: The bot-level override for one MCP server, the Manifest's closed set. Every field is optional; a field left out takes the user-level or Center value at apply time, which the revision does not pin (#2859). Header names as written (unique case-insensitively, a Registry check); transport upper-cased.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL with a non-empty host and no userinfo (no 'user:token@'), so a credential is never stored in a revision; the Registry also applies the Manifest's parse check (urlsplit with a hostname).

headers.description: HTTP headers sent to the server, name to value. Stored as written, so they must not carry credentials (#2860).

endpoint_env.description: Which of the server's registered endpoints to use.

mcpServerEntry.description: One MCP server enabled on this bot, keyed by server_code, with an optional bot-level override. User-level MCP config and Center defaults are not in the revision; apply reads them (#2859).

server_code.description: The server's code in the MCP registry, e.g. 'mcp.ant.homistudio.meetmcp'.

config.description: The bot-level override; absent means no override.

spec.description: What the bot is: every category of its definition, each a list of key + value entries (README §4). Hashed into revision.id. Every category is present, even when empty, and no other key is allowed (additionalProperties: false).

memory.description: Curated memory. oneOf: exactly one of the alternatives matches, so the value is either null (the bot has no curated memory) or a memorySpec.

resources.description: Workspace files and directories, sorted by path.

tools.description: Tools the bot uses. Only MCP servers in v1; CLI tools are not part of genome v1.

engine_config.description: Always {} in v1, until #2858 defines keys and value types.

script.description: The bot's startup script. oneOf: either null (no script) or an object with the script body's digest.

policy.description: What automated actors may change on this bot (README §5). Hashed into revision.id; no patch can change it.

mutable_genes.description: Gene paths patches may change; anything not covered is off limits. Sorted, unique gene paths.

pins.description: Gene paths no patch may touch, even inside a mutable gene (e.g. persona/SAFETY.md). Sorted, unique gene paths.

risk_overrides.description: Gene path to a risk tier for changes that touch it; can only raise an op's default tier (README §6.3).

provenance.description: Who recorded the revision. A strategy_run revision names its run; a user revision has neither run_id nor step.

kind.description: user: a person, through the genome API. strategy_run: a strategy during an Evolution Run.

actor.description: A user id, or a strategy 'id@version'.

run_id.description: strategy_run only: the Evolution Run that produced the revision.

step.description: strategy_run only: the strategy's own label for the step, e.g. 'propose'.

seq.description: Per-bot counter for people (r1, r42, ...); not an identity.

bot.description: The bot this revision belongs to.

parent.description: The revision this one was made from; null only for the bot's first revision.

created_at.description: When it was recorded, UTC, RFC 3339 with a Z suffix.

status.description: Where the revision is in its lifecycle (01-genome.md §4.4). Besides status, only annotations and the append-only evaluations change after recording.

patch_digest.description: The stored patch that turned parent into this revision; null when a whole Manifest document was recorded.

evidence.description: The Experience records that motivated the change; [] for most manual edits. At most 100.

evaluations.description: Ids of the Verification evaluations run on this revision; scores stay in Verification. Append-only: [] at record time, then Verification appends an id when an evaluation of this revision finishes.

annotations.description: Free-form labels added after recording, e.g. {'experiment': 'escalation-wording'}.
